name: Tafjord ski trek — native Kartverket terrain candidates

method.objective: Horizontal distance weighted by 1 + P*(10*grade + 6**(5*grade-1) - 1/6), grade=tan(terrain slope), P=1 default or 2 for stronger avoidance. No low-slope cutoff.
method.candidate_policy: One objective for all candidates. Local rerouting of 1 km windows in a 300 m neighborhood; retain geographically distinct basins, not weight variants.
method.source: Kartverket NHM DTM, nhm_dtm_topo_25832, EPSG:25832, native 1 m grid
method.heading_rule: On the 10 m gradient field above 10 degrees, deviation from uphill/downhill fall line <= 90 - 3*slope degrees.
method.grid: 4 m mesh; endpoint neighborhoods refined at 1 m; every edge checked against native 1 m slope and 10 m heading fields.
method.validation: Independent exact segment/cell integration, recomputing gradients from cached float elevations. Reported slope figures describe this terrain model.
method.day1_under20: No sub-20° candidate to Torsbu was found in the tested search. This is not proof that no route exists.
method.scope: Terrain-only ground model; snow cover, ice and avalanche exposure are not modeled. Discrete finite-coverage candidates, not proven global optima.

terrain_validation.warning: Kartverket 1 m terrain checks; fall-line direction measured across 10 m. Planning candidates, not field-verified tracks. Day 1 exceeds the requested 20-degree preference; inspect its reported native terrain maximum.
